title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
description: Showed BERT was significantly undertrained. Removing NSP, training longer, using dynamic masking, and larger batches improved performance substantially. Best practices for BERT-style training.
authors: Liu, Ott, Goyal, Du, Joshi, Chen, Levy, Lewis, Zettlemoyer, Stoyanov
